notes.title: Update notes for October 20th
notes.notes:
1. On boot, the language will default to the system language (if supported) instead of English.
2. Fixed an issue where discarding a slice of meat made players unable to progress. Now you can get more meat if you need it!
3. Improved ring visibility with a touch of sparkle to help players find it that little bit easier.
4. Improved Ranjit's movement in the forest. No more getting stuck!
5. Slight Spanish (Latinamerica) localisation fix: replacing 'Hogar' with 'Chimenea'

notes.title: Vlad Circus: Descend into Madness is available now!
notes.notes:
The wait is over! Vlad Circus: Descend into Madness, the 2D pixel-art horror adventure from developer Indiesruption ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1272580/Nine_Witches_Family_Disruption]Nine Witches[/url]) and publisher Blowfish Studios, is finally here!

On a day of sudden tragedy, Vlad Circus’ joyous reputation was replaced with sorrow and mourning. Hundreds were killed in the blazing fire, performers and attendees alike, forcing the once tight-knit troupe to disband. After eight years of no contact, a mysterious letter from the circus’ former ring leader brings the group together again. 

Peer into the fractured mind of former circus clown Oliver Mills, aka “Lazy Ollie.'' Maintain Ollie’s stress levels while exploring the dark halls of the Victorian-inspired Petrescu Manor. Rekindle old bonds from happier days, even as unspeakable horrors lurk in the shadows.

Hazy memories and grotesque hallucinations plague Ollie’s senses, worsening the deeper he dares to venture. Encounter and survive the horrifying abominations stalking the halls of the mansion while conquering mysterious puzzles. Reclaim lost memories from that traumatic day, piecing together the terrifying truth before Ollie’s sanity runs out completely. 

Are you ready to test your sanity?

notes.title: Vlad Circus: Descend into Madness is launching October 17, 2023!
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce that the wait is almost over! [b]Vlad Circus: Descend into Madness[/b], the 2D pixel-art horror adventure from developer Indiesruption (Nine Witches) and publisher Blowfish Studios, will launch on [b]Tuesday, October 17, 2023[/b], right on time for Halloween!

In the year 1921, the beloved Vlad Circus fell to a devastating fire, killing hundreds of innocents and forever scarring the survivors. Haunted by the tragedy, the circus troupe disbanded, only to be reunited by a mysterious invitation from their original ringleader eight years later. 

Explore the eerie halls of the Victorian-inspired Petrescu Manor as Oliver Mills, better known as his clown persona “Lazy Ollie.” Several years in the Pennhurst Asylum have proved ineffective in restoring his memories, but reconnecting with old friends and a lost love may do the trick. Unease festers in Ollie as he explores the shadowy estate, unaware of the sinister secret dying to be set free.

Vlad Circus will also be part of the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/nextfest]Steam Next Fest: October Edition[/url][/b] - don’t miss your chance from [b]October 9th to 16th[/b] to download and play the demo!

Prepare to descend into madness.

If you’re excited, please show the game some love by wishlisting it 💖

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1702430/Vlad_Circus_Descend_Into_Madness/
